a-destained-young-master-villain:
As soon as Trent became conscious of his reincarnation within a novel, he was promptly acquaintanced with an introductory mechanical system sound that identified itself as “Destiny.”
The novel is set in an imaginative realm where elements of science fiction, fantasy, swords, and magic intertwine.
The main character possesses a merciless demeanor, astuteness, impeccable physical traits, overwhelming power, and an unrivaled temperament.
Trent assumed the identity of Zenryx, whose background in this world exhibited great nobility and commanded a high level of prestige. He is consistently greeted with utmost respect and graciousness everywhere he goes. Power? Prestige? Wealth? Appearance? No one could even closely rival him.
Trent demonstrated a preference for efficiency over exertion, as he adhered to the principle of “working smarter, not harder.”
However, Trent's exceptional talent and remarkable aptitude enabled him to consistently astound everyone, even in the absence of extensive training.
Explore the intriguing portrayal of Zenryx's manipulation of the novel's protagonist and the intricate influence he holds over those around him.
a-wild-man-has-entered-the-academy: Usually when you possess a novel, you start in the city, but I fell into the forest.
after-being-reborn-and-regaining-her-ide:
[Time Travel + Online Shopping Mall + Sweet Petting + Sudden Wealth + Strong Female Lead + Abusive Scum Male Lead]
An Zhi Xia was born and immediately had her identity swapped out. She was harmed by the fake rich miss and her foster parents until no bones remained.
After drifting for a hundred years as a ghost, she watched with her own eyes as the fake rich miss assumed her identity to marry into a prestigious family, achieving success in both career and love. The fake rich miss also angered An Zhi Xia’s birth parents to death, and left her four brothers either dead or disabled.
Upon returning to the 1970s when she was harmed, the hundred-year-old ghost An Zhi Xia decisively counterattacked. She acknowledged her birth parents, drove away the fake rich miss, and sent her foster parents to prison.
Did you think she wanted familial love?
No, she only wanted the villains to pay the price.
But things often go beyond one’s expectations. An Zhi Xia’s big brother doted on her, second brother cherished her, third brother loved her, fourth brother protected her. As for her mother, she was always worried about the fake rich miss, but that no longer mattered.…
after-betrayal-lightning-marriage-to-mr-:
Witnessing her ex-boyfriend and best friend getting together, Isabella Weaver impulsively decided to have a flash marriage!
After the wedding, Isabella led a more thrilling life.
The neighbor's dog bit her, and the next day the neighbor disappeared and the dog was missing.
Her boss harassed her, and the next day the company was emptied and the boss vanished.
The principal wanted to expel her, and the next day the school was closed and the principal disappeared.
Her biological father hit her, and the next day the house was gone with her father and stepmother both missing!
Isabella was a bit panicked. Just who was this husband she randomly picked up on the street?
“Sir, could you please introduce yourself? I can't handle too much shock!”
The man calmly replied, “My identity, your husband, the rest, unimportant.”
(The most pampering and sweetest on the entire internet! There's none like it! After reading this book, you won't need to eat sweets because—you'll be sweetened to death.)
apocalypse-circular:
In the Wasteland Era, four grand circular walls separates the world of humans from the Exotic Species, which people also refer to as the Apocalypse Circular.
Lu Luo has unexpectedly arrived in this world and, feeling somewhat helpless amidst the sudden crisis, has seen this prompt in his vision:
[You are so weak it's suffocating, Although you have awakened Grade S-02-Devourer and Grade S-04-Fusioner, it's actually pretty useless.
The only thing that can truly help you escape this crisis and lead you to the pinnacle of life is Sequence S-11-Observer.]
[The above evaluation comes from the noble Grade S Sequence-11: Observer's fair analysis.]
Lu Luo: “? This evaluation, so fair huh!”
billionaires-long-journey-of-chasing-his:
Tong Airui was kicked in the ribs by a little girl!
The news spread, and his brothers and sisters were instantly in an uproar.
“Who is that girl? Let's avenge Fourth Brother!”
Who is the little girl?
The purple-clad car goddess on the racetrack, the beautiful girl at the chessboard, and she's been bearing a nickname for more than ten years: sweeping star!
Eighteen car accidents, and she was present at every one!
Sure enough! Whoever meets her is unlucky!
But what puzzled Yi Luowa was:
Even the dog next door started avoiding her, yet why does that cunning wolf refuse to leave?
When she first felt life was meaningless, it was him who tightly held her hand.
“As long as I'm alive, the sky won't fall on you!”
From then on, her world was bright!
[Maid Chapter]
One day, Tong Airui was thirsty, “Yi Luowa, I want to drink water!”
“Your mouth is below your nose, drink if you want!” a certain woman pouted, glancing at the man sitting beside her and said, “Old Eighth, I'm thirsty.”
Old Eighth hurriedly brought water to her hand, “Drink it, I've cooled it for you.”
Yi Luowa happily took a sip, just one sip, before Tong Airui snatched it away with a dark expression.…
bound-to-three-alphas:
Liana, a humble omega raised in silence, awakens on her 18th birthday with the scent of her fated mate — the son of the Alpha. But the bond isn't simple. The Alpha has triplet sons, and all three begin to feel the pull toward her. Thrust into the center of political tension and pack rivalry, Liana must confront betrayal, ancient magic, and a forgotten prophecy.
As she finds herself entangled with Kael, the stoic firstborn, Jace, the charming troublemaker, and Rowan, the cursed empath, Liana discovers she is more than she was told. Her wolf is the reincarnation of a Luna lost to betrayal. Her bloodline is royal, hidden in shadow. And her destiny is not to choose a mate but to unite a broken world.
With Celeste, the Beta's daughter, unraveling in jealousy and Darius, a rogue Alpha with vengeance in his heart, threatening war, Liana must rise. Not as an omega. Not as a mate. But as the Luna fated to reshape the future.
checking-in-for-100000-years:
Ye Yun has transmigrated into a martial world filled with gods, demons, monsters, and ghosts, becoming the Dragon God Sect Master. After checking in for 100,000-years, he resurrects from an ancient tomb, brandishing Emperor Level, God Level, and even Super God Level divine weapons and cultivation techniques to the astonishment of his disciples.
“Old Ancestor, this Divine Marrow Cleansing Pill is so precious! I really can't bear to consume it!”
“Don't be reluctant to take it. This gourd contains ten thousand more Divine Marrow Cleansing Pills. You could eat them like candy, and it wouldn't be a problem...”
criminal-x-epitome-of-evil:
Pablo Castillo was the worst, the evilest, the biggest criminal in the whole world. He was the ominous figure known as Criminal X.
It’s a name that sends shivers down the spines of those who utter it. His past, a mysterious enigma, shrouded in darkness, only adds to the legend of the world’s most notorious criminal.
However, Pablo’s reign of heinous crimes comes to an abrupt end when a specially trained military force, an elite group made especially to capture Pablo, finally apprehended him.
The capture of Criminal X sent shockwaves around nations, for this man had defied all laws and moral boundaries. The world watched as he was brought to the highest court to face the consequences of a lifetime of malevolence.
The International Court of Justice, in a bid to administer justice that matches the magnitude of his crimes, bestowed upon him the most excruciating execution ever conceived.
The world erupted in celebration as news of his demise spread like wildfire. An international holiday was declared, a day of liberation from the tyranny of Pablo Castillo. The day was named with triumphant fervor. They all called it—World Independence Day.…
cultivating-in-secret-beside-a-demoness:
Jiang Hao transmigrated and was born into an ordinary household. His family was forced to sell him off into a demonic sect and he became a disciple.
He planned to cultivate, gradually become stronger, and live a peaceful life in the cultivation world. However, he was humiliated constantly by a demoness.
The difference in their abilities was astronomical. He had no choice but to endure the humiliation, hoping that he never would have to encounter her again.
He, who had no backing, caught the eye of the leader of the sect and finally could cultivate in peace. When he became the head disciple and met with the sect leader, he was stunned.
As he looked at the other party’s beautiful face, he was stunned. Wasn’t this person the demoness from before?
“My dual cultivation partner is actually the sect’s patriarch?! ”
”Should I tell her that everyone in this sect is a spy?“
death-game-starting-as-a-trickster-prete:
“When I thought death was the end, I opened my eyes only to realize… it was just a new beginning.”
After being killed by a junior he thought was going to confess to him, Lin Yu discovered he hadn’t actually died. Instead, he found himself in a deadly game!
Only the winner has a chance to “live again.”
Luckily, Lin Yu awakened the unique class — Fraudster:
【Any lie he tells, as long as someone believes it, becomes reality!】
Watching the other players, all lost and confused, Lin Yu chose to pretend to be a god in order to win the game!
“Welcome to my game — little lambs!”
And in the endless string of death games that followed…
With the power of the 【Fraudster】, Lin Yu eventually became a real god!
death-mage-with-an-ss-rank-talent:
The World was thrown into chaos with the arrival of monsters but the humans were given a chance of awakening powers.
The MC who was once used to read stories like that was now reincarnated in such world.
This is his story on how he would proceed in this troublesome world.
divine-convenience-store:
Lin Mo, a man from Earth, finds himself inexplicably transported to the ethereal Realm of Nine Heavens after dying from a traffic accident.
His new, and utterly bizarre, occupation? Running the Divine Convenience Store, a celestial store catering to the needs of immortals, cultivators, and mortals alike.
Watch as he navigates this otherworldly realm and learn that managing a shop for divine beings to spread their influence comes with a hazard
dragon-who-controls-time:
The Northern Ice Fields had no boundaries.
The Winter Wolves hid within the snow, the Frost Tigers growled incessantly, and the roars of Giants echoed throughout the land. Many species struggled to survive in the icefield. At the same time, a baby White Dragon possessing the power of time broke out of its egg and opened its platinum-colored eyes.
Years later, the legendary Time Dragon appeared, moving freely between the endless past, present, and future.
embroidered-uniform-guard-i-can-plunder-:
After crossing over to a martial world, Ye Liuyun unexpectedly becomes an Embroidered Uniform Guard, a special police force.
Ye Liuyun resolved to step onto the path of Martial Arts, and coincidentally awakened the Talent Entry system.
“Innate Sword Physique: Quickly master any swordsmanship in the world, and integrate them seamlessly.”
“Embrace All Rivers: Able to absorb spiritual qi from heaven and earth, infinitely enhancing one's cultivation level.”
“Born Supreme: Experience growth a hundredfold, ignoring any negative effects brought by cultivation techniques.”
hollywood-lights-ink-entertainment:
Transmigration.
The word still hit Regal like a cold splash of water - a reminder of how his old life, against all his wild imagination, had ended in the least cinematic way possible.
No heroic sacrifice. No tearful goodbyes. Not even a poetic monologue.
Just… poof.
Lights out, curtains down, and show over.
Yet, here he was, still alive.
Regal Seraphsail - same name, same dreams, but in a world fourteen years into the past.
New packaging, though.
It was December 2009, in a world that was almost - but not quite - Earth.
Then, there was The System.
It rewarded him with skills, scripts, and creativity, all tailored to help him become the greatest storyteller this world had ever seen.
For Regal, it was the perfect tool.
Because, with or without it, Regal’s singular dream had always been cinema - and he will achieve it this time.
From writing world-changing stories to directing films that redefined the industry, Regal was determined to become the biggest figure Hollywood had ever seen.
His first step?
Penning a book called＜Harry Potter＞and watching it take the world by storm.
=====
Points to be noted:
- This is a Parallel World.…
house-dads-literary-life:
Right after transmigrating into a parallel world, Yang Yi was a bit stupefied upon seeing a adorable little girl calling him father. Fine, Xixi is 100% my daughter, but my child’s mother is actually an aloof, absolute beauty who’s a famous singer.
How do I coax my baby? Yang Yi, who was a assassin in his previous life, scratched his head. How about I tell some stories? Yang Yi didn’t think that the stories he imported from his previous world would be famous world-wide! How do I bring back my child’s mother who left in anger? The experienced Yang Yi indicated that there was no problem a love song couldn’t fix. And if it couldn’t, then two songs!
how-to-survive-as-a-mage-inside-a-game: I became a mage character from my favorite game.
i-dont-want-to-be-an-ojakgyo:
I was reincarnated as the supporting character of a novel.
As a wingwoman in a depressing romance novel titled at that. Romance is out of the question, and the future of my family is ominous because of debt.
I was going to become a civil servant to gain some of the splendor I never got in my last life…but the male love interests are acting kind of strange?!
“Just think about it, does Shushu look like someone who would blush and act shy?”
“Wow…….that would be great.” Cory said as he stared at Hylli in a daze, and Yves frowned and whispered to himself.
“Should I just kidnap her…….”
Swan wrapped his face with both of his hands and stayed quiet. His face turned bright red. The blush turned his ears red.
Why are you guys fooling around, you’re supposed to be obsessing over the heroine.
The story of Shuraina West, Shushu’s reverse harem academy survival.
Note: Ojakgyo means wingman/woman!
i-somehow-ended-up-with-a-harem-full-of-:
After dying at the hands of her abusive boyfriend, Krystina awakens in a vibrant and fantastical world, filled with captivating beast men who embody both fierce instincts and profound emotions. Each beast man, adorned with striking features and unique abilities, views her as a rare treasure—an invaluable prize worth fighting for. They compete for her affection, displaying their strengths while grappling with their primal urges and instincts that threaten to overwhelm them.
Torn between her gratitude for this unexpected second chance in life and the haunting memories of her tumultuous past, Krys must navigate a web of romantic tensions and precarious alliances. As she forms deep connections with these diverse and passionate beings, she begins to unravel the complexities of love and trust.
However, her journey is complicated by the darker forces at play within this new world. She soon discovers that the stakes are much higher than just her heart; the fate of the beast men’s realm hangs in the balance, caught in the throes of an impending tribal warfare that could alter the course of their existence forever.…
infinite-fighting:
You have a Limited Space, where you can store the essences of your fighting skills and release them for use when needed. You can also synthesize a certain number of same-level fighting skill essences into a complete fighting skill crystal or a higher-level fighting skill crystal.
...
After Zhang Ji transmigrated into this fighting game world, the most precious lesson he learned was that only by fighting can you get everything you want.
into-skyrim-elder-scrolls-8-nirns-beta:
So to begin, this is technically a skyrim fanfic.
Why isn't it in the fan-fics then?
Simple! It's based on a game and I don't feel that counts as a fan-fic.
Second, I've read like a few skyrim stories here lately. I liked them, as a bethesda fan boy... Well, now I need to take a crack at it. I literally start a new game of skyrim every new year. Its my tradition, so I felt I had to do this.
If its bad, ah well. If its good, GREAT! Overall though, I feel we need more skyrim based stories or fan-fics. It has the perfect setting for the transmigration genre. Now read at your own risk.
island-survival-i-build-a-moving-castle-:
Upon waking up, Shi Zhile went from being a paraplegic to a normal person.
But she is now trapped in a deserted island survival game.
Starting with just an island, and it's covered in rubble?
The raft is a scam, and the system is a huge pitfall?
Just watch how she builds!
Day 1, no golden finger, no shelter.
System: There's no typhoon.
The typhoon arrives.
She survives by sheer stubbornness, builds a shelter from scraps, and tries fishing to find food.
She catches a pile of rotten underwear.
Also, there are sea monsters.
This life is impossible!
Day 2, the golden finger arrives!!!
It doubles whatever she has.
…So now she has twice as much rotten underwear.
------
What do you do with a Wish System that can disguise itself and grant wishes without caring if the host lives or dies?
The system wants her dead. But it truly underestimates how stubborn a former paraplegic can be.
it-seems-that-ive-slipped-into-a-differe: I, Seiren Shikino grew up in an orphanage. On the day of my high school graduation, I somehow got transported to another world, and turned into a girl as well. ……Eh, this isn’t my original world and gender, right!? It seems that I’m now Seiren, the daughter of a noble from another world. This is a light hearted story about family and romance.
kiss-with-mr-ceo:
Fate is a funny thing.
A random stranger Chen Yi kissed to piss off her ex turned out to be the CEO of the Li Corporations?
Chen Yi, the girl with impeccable beauty that could trample the heavens and devastate earth-eyes like dark shimmering brown gemstones, hair like a cascade of chocolate brown color. Skin pale like snow. Features delicate and flawless like a porcelain doll.
Abandoned and wronged by her family, cheated by her ex, betrayed by her cousin...
Sounds usual, doesn’t it?
But things take an exciting turn when a certain CEO appears a at her doorstep with a contract in his hands.
“It’s your choice. Either pay for the losses caused by you or sign this contract and become my wife.”
One kiss and she was bound with the formidable CEO for her life.
-Sneak peek into a chapter-
“Mr. Li, could you exclude the term of the conjugal relationship between the married couple?”
Li Luxian was momentarily surprised to hear that. Then the mischievous smile returned to his lips.
“May I ask why? Could it be you don’t find my body attractive enough?”
Chen Yi was speechless.
Of course, he was attractive. He was simply a god for his looks.…
library-of-heavens-path-2-eternal-fate-o:
One of the four greatest braggarts in the web novel circle, Zhang Xuan, has entered the 【Source World】, a higher dimensional plane even above the Empyrean.
With the complete version of the Library of Heaven’s Path that encompasses the capacities of the 【Heavens’ Imperfections】, 【Heavens’ Order】, and 【Heavens’ Nature】, he embarks on an adventure — showcasing his might — across the world!
Searching for Fate, Resigning Oneself to Fate, Knowing One’s Fate, Commanding Fate... While all of you are still cultivating your fate, seeking fate, or borrowing fate, I, Zhang Xuan, already possess the ’Eternal Fate of the Heavens’!
mated-to-father-fated-to-sons:
From virgin to Ryker's play toy, Rowan's obsession and Corvin's lustful desire. Amaris is that good girl turn bitch!
*******
Sold to the father.
Fated to the sons.
Desired by all three.
Amaris Storme was sent as an arranged mate, a peace offering to a cold, grieving Alpha who refuses to touch her. But the moment she steps into his territory, everything goes wrong.
Because the bond doesn’t choose him.
It chooses his heirs.
One twin wants her out of spite.
One twin wants her but cannot claim her.
The father wants nothing, until he wants everything.
Father and sons are driven onto opposite sides, each pulled toward the same woman they should not want. Old wounds reopen and the pack begins to split from the inside out with Amaris at the center of the storm.
She was never meant to belong to them all. Now none of them are willing to let her go.
Three Alpha wolves. One forbidden bond.
ministers-begging-me-to-ascend-the-thron:
After being reincarnated as the youngest son of Emperor Wu of Zhou, Zhao Yao was not favored much. In order to survive the bloody power struggle for the throne, he had to bide his time. Finally, he grew up and was granted a title of nobility, only to be exiled to the distant region of Lingnan by his dear father.
It was said that Lingnan was incredibly poor, but Zhao Yao was not afraid. He focused on infrastructure and production. Under Zhao Yao's management, Lingnan transformed from a place of exile into a prosperous land.
Just when Zhao Yao was happily living his carefree life in Lingnan, the ministers traveled a thousand miles to beg him to ascend the throne.
Zhao Yao was baffled. Had these ministers lost their minds?
moto-sekai-ichii-no-sub-chara-ikusei-nik:
He never performed well in either middle nor high school, and even after becoming an adult, he never worked. Be it morning, noon or night, he only played an online game. For him, being the world’s number one rank, playing that online game, was his very reason for living.
One day, his account was hacked and his character deleted. Restoration was impossible. Nothing that could be done. The number 1 rank that he literally spent his life to attain and to defend was now lost. Filled with despair, he turned to suicide.
When he opened his eyes again, there was the online game. No, the world itself looked similar to the game. He had been reborn as the extra character of the premium avatar he created in the past, but left untouched.
The former world’s top, was reborn in a world that looked like that online game. That was the beginning of his extraordinary legend.
A knight, a cat, a dark elf, and so on. Together with several unique companions, his training to regain his “world’s first rank” now begins.
my-amnesic-ex-married-my-sister-so-i-mar:
[Flash Marriage + Marriage Before Love + Family Crematorium + Long-Planned + Mutual Redemption + Sweet Fluff]
When her ex-boyfriend, who lost his memory in a car accident, announced his engagement to her own sister, Stella Sterling met a wild man in Lumina. She helped him on a whim, but the wild man said, “That was my first kiss. My family is very strict. Would you please marry me?”
The wild man has a past he refuses to speak of; she has a first love she can't bear to look back on. A flash marriage—she thought it was a tacit partnership.
Later, someone came to Owen Rhodes to complain, saying Stella Sterling’s smoking and drinking were improper, that her revealing clothes were a disgrace, and that her cursing and fighting were ruining the family's reputation.
Owen Rhodes: “My wife is the most well-behaved and obedient person. She's too timid to cause trouble. The fault is definitely yours. Apologize.”
The complainant: How about you take a look at the injuries on my face first?
——————
Owen Rhodes has a secret. From the age of 18 to 28, he has been using another person's name to accompany a bright and passionate girl.…
my-gluttony-system-i-devour-god-tier-tal:

WARNING: DIMENSIONAL BARRIERS DETERIORATING
Brett Lenhart was a modern man who lost his life to a stupid distraction—looking at the wrong thing at the wrong time.
He wakes in a deal struck with a goddess whose divine beauty masks dangerous intentions. Now he's Kyrie Shaw, the unwilling avatar of a fragmented god, thrust into a world built on steam, brass, and ambition where Victorian empires clash across dimensional borders.
Here, mental power separates the worthy from the worthless. Prophets manipulate futures in oligarchic courts. Warriors prove strength through psionic combat in meritocratic empires. Technocrats hide world-breaking science behind industrial smoke. And in the ruins of a war-torn realm, beast-kin survivors fight against monsters born from despair itself.…
my-werepanther-system-starting-with-nine:
Since the opening of the Dungeon Rifts-- also called D.Rifts or Drift Dimensions, the world has changed. It's become more militaristic and violent-- unpredictable, even. Monsters raze cities and bring diseases that birth new races. Magic exists in a constant state of hyperflux, birthing new powers and changing the functions of old ones.
But none of that mattered for Rex. He wasn't a Drift Soldier-- as much as he wanted to be. He didn't have powers-- even if he wished he did, so when he graduated primary school, he expected to get his Drift Armament and find a bit of consistency for once in his life.
But you know what they say about expectations......
DING!
[Congratulations! You have awakened the Beast-Totem and unlocked your Werepanther System.]
[5 Totems Remaining....]
*********
Extra tags: kingdom building, military, martial arts, overpowered, scifi-fantasy, post-apocalyptic, factions,
no-fighting-allowed-in-the-inn:
In the martial world, disputes often lead to immediate violence, frequently harming innocent, unarmed civilians who either lose their wealth or their lives.
Lu Jianwei merely complained a few times when she was suddenly bound by a system and transported to ancient times, tasked with running an inn according to the system’s rules.
The foremost rule of the inn is—
No fighting within the inn.
Violators will either lose their wealth or their lives.
A mysterious inn suddenly appeared in the martial world, rumored to be a shady establishment dealing in mu*der and robbery.
No matter who enters the inn, they either leave penniless or lose their lives.…
only-i-can-see-the-end:
Mikey has been having dreams (nightmares) every night, for the past ten years.
His dreams tread the realm beyond the ordinary, showing Dungeons, Monsters, magic-like occurrences, and the literal end of the world.
But, what happens when the dreamer wakes up, only to find out that the things he has been seeing in these nightmares have started to appear in reality?
Now faced with an inevitable fate that draws closer, Mikey must do all he can to ensure the grim future he witnessed doesn’t occur.
For the sake of himself, and everyone he grows to care about, he must.
“… Win or die trying!”
parallel-memory:
A person's perspective plays a vital role in developing one's personality. What happens when you realize the world you live in is the same as a Novel.
Zero Elea gets a Skill called Parallel Memory which allowed him to get the memory of his alternative self of a different universe.
He realizes that the world he lives in is similar to the novel he used to read in his alternative world. The world will face catastrophe in the future but there is no need to worry as there is a main character working hard to save the world.
And what about me? I am but a mob character.
pastoral-daily-life:
Lu Lingxi died.
As a child born by his parents through precise genetic matching, for eighteen years of his life, he lived entirely for his brother, who had leukaemia. He was his brother’s shadow, a “medicine reserve bank” for his brother’s treatment needs.
Umbilical cord blood, stem cells, bone marrow… whenever his brother needed it, he would have no choice but to quietly lie on the operating table.
Until the last time, when his brother needed a kidney and he never came off the operating table.
When he opened his eyes again, Lu Lingxi became a teenager with the same name Lu Lingxi.
Freed from the shackles of his fate, he possesses the mysterious ability to communicate with plants.
Raising flowers, gardening and running a farm, Lu Lingxi begins a very different life!
rebirth-in-the-50s-the-couple-with-the-h:
Zhang Guoqing and his pregnant wife Zhou Jiao, orphans from the 21st century, were working hard to build a better future when they unexpectedly inherited a vast fortune. But on their way to the hospital for the birth of their child, a deliberate car accident sent them hurtling back in time.
Awakening in the bodies of a young couple in a rural village during the 1950s, they find themselves facing a life of hardship and uncertainty. Yet, they carry with them secrets from the future—Zhang Guoqing possesses a mysterious advantage, while Zhou Jiao has a hidden space with endless possibilities.
Together, they navigate the challenges of their new life, determined to protect their family and create a warm, prosperous future in this era of scarcity.
rebirth-inheriting-millions-in-the-eight:
(Historical Romance + Family Affection + Wealth Accumulation + Feel-Good/Light Novel)
The money-loving Film Queen Xia Ningxing time-traveled into an eight-year-old cute kid in a historical setting.
Not only did she have five brothers who doted on her as if she were their life, but she also had a mother who treasured her like a precious gem, and most importantly, the future tycoon male lead lived next door.
However, in the story, the male lead died young, leaving behind a huge inheritance. To be able to inherit this wealth, Film Queen Xia Ningxing began her pursuit plan in reverse.
Later, the male lead pushed Ningxing against the corner of the wall, “I heard that you're marrying me just to wait for my early demise so you can inherit my wealth?”
“......” Oops! Caught red-handed!
“Too bad, this time I won't neglect my health for the sake of my career. My last health check was normal in all aspects, I should live at least to a hundred years old.”
“!!!!!”
She never expected that the tycoon doomed to die young was actually reborn!
(New book “Eighties” Family Darling At Five And A Half is out~)
reborn-wife-ill-chase-happiness-instead-:
Sophia Pagemoore Willowmarch's first life ends when her husband's mistress fatally stabs her and then pushes her off a bridge.
After she dies, Sophia awakens three years earlier, a few months into her failed marriage with Jace Willowmarch, a brigadier general in the Northern Realm's military. This time, she won't put up with the green-tea bitch, the cheating husband, or the nasty nobles who bullied her.
However, there is ONE surprise in her second-chance life. Duke Nathan Stonehart. For reasons she can't fathom, the man is utterly devoted to her.
Sophia is determined to rewrite her life story and avoid her previous fate. Yet, she finds herself caught between the husband who wants to pay penance for his neglect, and the handsome duke who swears he will love only her for this life and the next.
What's a reborn wife supposed to do now?
reincarnated-as-a-demon-inside-a-dungeon:
When people die, where do they end up to?
